testcase.name: ROVC-TC-001: Task 1 Qualification Gate Nominal Traversal
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-001 - Task 1 Qualification Gate Nominal Traversal Case Type: Functional | Priority: High Preconditions: Arena pool (20m x 10m) filled to 1.8m depth; qualification gate with 1.0m clear internal width positioned at 1.2m depth; ROV ballasted for neutral buoyancy; ~50m tether connected to surface control station. Test Steps: 1. Deploy the ROV into the designated poolside staging zone and verify surface telemetry link. 2. Command vertical descent to align vehicle centerline with the 1.2m gate passage depth. 3. Apply surge forward thrust to traverse through the 1.0m wide gate aperture. 4. Maintain straight heading until vehicle stern and trailing tether segment completely clear the gate exit plane. Verifiable Assertions: 1. Vehicle maintains stable depth at 1.2m ± 0.05m during gate approach. 2. ROV traverses through the 1.0m gate opening with zero physical contact against uprights or crossbar. 3. Trailing tether clears the gate structure without snagging, looping, or displacing gate anchoring buoys. 4. Official judge scorekeeper logs a clean qualification passage on attempt 1.

testcase.name: ROVC-TC-002: Task 1 Gate Passage Lateral Clearance Boundary (1.00m Gate Opening)
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-002 - Task 1 Gate Passage Lateral Clearance Boundary (1.00m Gate Opening) Case Type: Boundary | Priority: High Preconditions: Submerged gate measured and calibrated to exactly 1.00m (100.0cm) clear internal width; vehicle width verified at 55cm; pool water still with zero surface turbulence. Test Steps: 1. Position the ROV 2.0m upstream of the 1.00m gate opening, offset laterally 20cm to the starboard upright. 2. Steer the vehicle through the gate with starboard thruster shroud passing within 5cm of the upright. 3. Monitor poolside video feed and underwater acoustic/optical sensors for contact indication. 4. Verify complete passage without deflection or physical touch. Verifiable Assertions: 1. Vehicle clears the 1.00m gate opening maintaining >=3cm measured clearance between thruster shroud and upright. 2. Zero physical contact occurs; no vibration or contact marker triggered. 3. Lateral clearance boundary validated as compliant under strict 1.00m aperture constraint.

testcase.name: ROVC-TC-003: Task 1 Submerged Depth Boundaries at 0.6m Minimum and 1.8m Maximum Limits
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-003 - Task 1 Submerged Depth Boundaries at 0.6m Minimum and 1.8m Maximum Limits Case Type: Boundary | Priority: High Preconditions: Pool depth gradient configured with 0.6m shallow shelf and 1.8m deep pit; hydrostatic depth sensor calibrated with ±0.01m accuracy. Test Steps: 1. Command the ROV to navigate the gate positioned at the shallow boundary depth of 0.60m. 2. Record vertical stability, surface wake, and thruster cavitation risk at 0.60m depth. 3. Relocate gate or transit vehicle to deep boundary pit at 1.80m depth. 4. Execute traversal at 1.80m depth and monitor internal hull pressure and ballast equilibrium. Verifiable Assertions: 1. Vehicle navigates gate at 0.60m depth without broaching water surface or cavitating thrusters. 2. Vehicle navigates gate at 1.80m depth without hull seal compression leakage or bottom grounding. 3. Closed-loop depth controller holds target depth within ±0.04m across both 0.6m and 1.8m operational extremes.

testcase.name: ROVC-TC-004: Task 1 Maximum 3-Attempt Gate Traversal Limit & Timing Penalty Evaluation
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-004 - Task 1 Maximum 3-Attempt Gate Traversal Limit & Timing Penalty Evaluation Case Type: Boundary | Priority: Medium Preconditions: Judge timing system active; 3-attempt quota initialized for Task 1; stopwatch synchronized. Test Steps: 1. Execute Attempt 1: Intentionally touch gate upright with thruster guard; record fault and abort. 2. Reset vehicle to start gate zone within the 2-minute reset window. 3. Execute Attempt 2: Cause gate abort by tether entanglement; record second fault. 4. Reset and execute Attempt 3: Execute clean contact-free gate passage. 5. Attempt an unauthorized 4th run to verify gate attempt lockout. Verifiable Assertions: 1. Judge records navigation faults for Attempt 1 and Attempt 2 with appropriate time penalties. 2. Attempt 3 successfully completes contact-free gate passage and awards qualification points. 3. System rejects 4th attempt; maximum 3-attempt rule enforced strictly.

testcase.name: ROVC-TC-005: Task 1 Thruster Stall and Gate Upright Collision Recovery
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-005 - Task 1 Thruster Stall and Gate Upright Collision Recovery Case Type: Exception | Priority: High Preconditions: Vehicle in active forward transit through qualification gate; telemetry monitor logging individual thruster currents. Vehicle yaw rate remains controllable or failsafe neutral buoyancy prevents violent rotation. 3. Hardened thruster shroud absorbs any incidental brush without hull deformation or gate damage. 4. Pilot initiates safe abort; vehicle is safely recovered without hazard to pool infrastructure.

testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-006 - Task 1 50m Tether Trailing Gate Contact & Snag Mitigation Case Type: Exception | Priority: Medium Preconditions: 50m umbilical tether deployed from pool deck; tether strain relief collar attached at vehicle stern. Soft bumper makes physical contact with balloon without rupturing or deflating it. 4. Successful touch verified by judge video review and full Task 2 points awarded.

testcase.name: ROVC-TC-010: Task 2 Soft-Touch Probe Contact Force Boundary Limit (Non-Destructive Touch)

testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-011 - Task 2 Onboard Illumination Electrical Circuit Failure in Unlit Pool Case Type: Exception | Priority: High Preconditions: ROV submerged at 1.5m depth in total darkness pool; light power relay mapped to test trip switch. testcase.name: ROVC-TC-013: Task 2 Target Balloon Rupture / Excessive Contact Force Penalty

testcase.name: ROVC-TC-014: Task 3 Section 1 Straight Path Surge & Heading Hold Traversal
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-014 - Task 3 Section 1 Straight Path Surge & Heading Hold Traversal Case Type: Functional | Priority: High Preconditions: Section 1 PVC maze straight corridor (width 1.2m, length 6.0m) submerged at 1.0m depth; heading gyroscope calibrated. testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-016 - Task 3 Section 3 1.5m High-Wall Narrow Channel Submerged Traversal Case Type: Functional | Priority: High Preconditions: Section 3 channel bounded by 1.5m vertical PVC walls; channel internal width 1.1m; top of wall at 0.3m depth, bottom at 1.8m. testcase.name: ROVC-TC-017: Task 3 Maze Wall Collision Penalty Deduction Boundary (<=5 Points per Contact)

testcase.name: ROVC-TC-018: Task 3 Section 3 Submerged Containment Boundary (Depth Hold vs Broaching)
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-018 - Task 3 Section 3 Submerged Containment Boundary (Depth Hold vs Broaching) Case Type: Boundary | Priority: High Preconditions: Section 3 wall top submerged at 0.30m below water surface; boundary depth alarm set at 0.40m. Vehicle completes traversal without broaching surface or traversing over wall tops.

testcase.name: ROVC-TC-019: Task 3 Surface Broaching Disqualification in High-Walled Passage
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-019 - Task 3 Surface Broaching Disqualification in High-Walled Passage Case Type: Exception | Priority: High Preconditions: Vehicle navigating Section 3 high-walled channel; official judge observing surface profile. testcase.name: ROVC-TC-020: Task 3 Dead-End Entrapment and Reverse Yaw Extraction

Vehicle re-enters main course and completes maze run within allowable overall time window.

testcase.name: ROVC-TC-021: Task 3 50m Tether Snag on Obstacle Pylon in Section 2
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-021 - Task 3 50m Tether Snag on Obstacle Pylon in Section 2 Case Type: Exception | Priority: High Preconditions: 50m umbilical tether snagged on Pylon 2; pilot observes sudden vehicle arrest and tether tension spike. Deck crew takes in slack to clear the pylon. Verifiable Assertions: 1. Snag detected before cable insulation tears or penetrator is damaged. 2. Counter-rotation successfully releases tether loop from pylon. 3. Forward motion resumes without needing poolside diver intervention.

testcase.name: ROVC-TC-025: Safety Constraint: External Hardware Kill Switch Actuation Latency (<100ms Cutoff)
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-025 - Safety Constraint: External Hardware Kill Switch Actuation Latency (<100ms Cutoff) Case Type: Security | Priority: High Preconditions: Vehicle secured on dry bench in water test tank; all thrusters commanded to 100% duty cycle; high-speed digital oscilloscope connected to motor ESC PWM/power rails. Actuator power bus disconnected in <80ms (strict compliance with <100ms requirement). 2. All thruster spinning halts immediately. 3. Auxiliary systems (grippers, pneumatics) safely de-energize. 4. Kill switch verified as hardwired and failsafe.

testcase.name: ROVC-TC-026: Safety Constraint: Kill Switch Latching Relay Failure / Actuator Runaway Exception
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-026 - Safety Constraint: Kill Switch Latching Relay Failure / Actuator Runaway Exception Case Type: Exception | Priority: High Preconditions: Vehicle on test bench; simulated welded relay contact on ESC power branch. Redundant dual-layer power cutoff prevents hazardous runaway in pool.

testcase.name: ROVC-TC-027: Electrical Constraint: Branch Fusing on 230V AC Supply and DC Motor ESC Rails
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-027 - Electrical Constraint: Branch Fusing on 230V AC Supply and DC Motor ESC Rails Case Type: Security | Priority: High Preconditions: Electrical distribution schematic inspected; multimeter and circuit tester available; vehicle open for bench audit. Verifiable Assertions: 1. Surface 230V AC power protected with rated fuse/breaker meeting IEC 60898. 2. Every motor branch individually fused; zero unfused power branches detected. 3. Reverse polarity protection prevents damage if leads are reversed. 4. Electrical safety audit marked PASS.

testcase.name: ROVC-TC-028: Electrical Constraint: Motor ESC Overcurrent Short-Circuit and Fuse Trip Exception
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-028 - Electrical Constraint: Motor ESC Overcurrent Short-Circuit and Fuse Trip Exception Case Type: Exception | Priority: High Preconditions: Vehicle bench test fixture; port surge motor ESC wired with calibrated 20A fast-acting fuse; artificial short-circuit simulator. testcase.name: ROVC-TC-029: Safety Constraint: Pneumatic Auxiliary System Pressure Limit (<=6.0 bar Ceiling)
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-029 - Safety Constraint: Pneumatic Auxiliary System Pressure Limit (<=6.0 bar Ceiling) Case Type: Boundary | Priority: High Preconditions: Calibrated pneumatic pressure gauge; vehicle equipped with pneumatic gripper or ballast accumulator. testcase.name: ROVC-TC-030: Safety Constraint: Pneumatic Regulator Overpressure Relief Valve Trip (>6.0 bar) Exception
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-030 - Safety Constraint: Pneumatic Regulator Overpressure Relief Valve Trip (>6.0 bar) Exception Case Type: Exception | Priority: High Preconditions: Pneumatic test bench with safety enclosure; regulator bypass valve installed. testcase.name: ROVC-TC-031: Environmental Safety: Zero Environmental Chemical/Oil Leakage Strict Containment
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-031 - Environmental Safety: Zero Environmental Chemical/Oil Leakage Strict Containment Case Type: Security | Priority: High Preconditions: Clean water test tank; white absorbent inspection paper; UV blacklight for fluorescent oil detection. testcase.name: ROVC-TC-032: Environmental Safety: Propeller Shaft Dynamic Seal Oil Drip & Run Abort Exception
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-032 - Environmental Safety: Propeller Shaft Dynamic Seal Oil Drip & Run Abort Exception Case Type: Exception | Priority: High Preconditions: Vehicle in competition arena; simulated oil release marker deployed. Test Steps: 1. Release trace biodegradable test fluorescent marker at propeller shaft during mission run. 2. Arena marshal detects sheen on pool surface and sounds immediate abort whistle. 3. Vehicle pilot immediately shuts down all thrusters via kill switch. 4. Poolside rescue team deploys oil absorbent boom and retrieves vehicle. Verifiable Assertions: 1. Mission terminated immediately upon environmental sheen detection. 2. Vehicle disqualified from current round per Section 7 zero-leakage mandate. 3. Vehicle barred from water until shaft seals are replaced and re-inspected.

testcase.name: ROVC-TC-033: Optical Safety: Class 2 Laser Boundary Rating (<1 mW Cutoff)
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-033 - Optical Safety: Class 2 Laser Boundary Rating (<1 mW Cutoff) Case Type: Boundary | Priority: Medium Preconditions: Calibrated optical power meter (spectroradiometer) at 532nm/650nm; vehicle laser diodes powered. Test Steps: 1. Measure optical power output of onboard parallel scaling lasers at 10cm aperture. 2. Verify laser power reading is <=0.95 mW (Class 2 limit < 1.0 mW). 3. Verify laser beam orientation is fixed strictly parallel to camera optical axis facing forward/downward. 4. Verify physical beam shroud prevents upward stray reflections toward spectator gallery. Verifiable Assertions: 1. Laser optical output measured at <1.0 mW meeting Class 2 safety standards (IEC 60825-1). 2. Beam alignment certified downward/forward away from judges and spectators. 3. Class 2 laser safety label affixed to vehicle hull.

testcase.name: ROVC-TC-034: Safety Constraint: Certified Lithium Battery Pack Regulatory Documentation Audit
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-034 - Safety Constraint: Certified Lithium Battery Pack Regulatory Documentation Audit Case Type: Security | Priority: High Preconditions: Technical documentation binder presented at Stage 4 VALIDATE gate; battery pack physically extracted for inspection. Valid UN 38.3 and manufacturer certificates verified and stamped by safety official. 2. Integrated BMS confirmed functional on all series cell groups. 3. Battery approved for competition pool operation.

testcase.name: ROVC-TC-035: Structural Constraint: Hydrostatic Pressure Hull Seal Boundary at 1.8m Pool Pit
testcase.system-out: Test Case: ROVC-TC-035 - Structural Constraint: Hydrostatic Pressure Hull Seal Boundary at 1.8m Pool Pit Case Type: Boundary | Priority: High Preconditions: Pool deep pit at 1.8m depth (hydrostatic pressure 0.18 bar gauge / ~118 kPa absolute); internal vacuum test kit or humidity telemetry sensor active. Test Steps: 1. Submerge vehicle to maximum pool depth of 1.80m for a continuous 20-minute soak period. 2. Monitor internal relative humidity and pressure telemetry via surface telemetry stream. 3. Cycle vertical thrusters to create dynamic pressure fluctuations around end-cap O-rings. 4. Retrieve vehicle and conduct internal visual inspection for droplet condensation. Verifiable Assertions: 1. Internal hull humidity remains constant (zero water ingress over 20-minute submersion). 2. O-ring seals withstand 0.18 bar static and dynamic head pressure without deformation. 3. Electronics enclosure interior remains 100% dry; pressure seal boundary verified.
